text.tspan: Existing model names; attendance-related members only. Solid associations show multiplicity, not execution order.
MULTIPLICITY: 1 = exactly one; 0..1 = optional; 0..* = zero or more. No arrowhead is required on a bidirectional association.
Customer represents both students and parents; ParentId links Customer to Customer. Notification.RecipientId points to User, not Customer.
For attendance notifications, AttendanceAuditLogId is present and unique; generic notifications can have no attendance audit. Each audit produces at most one notification.
Unique attendance key: (CustomerId, TimetableEntryId, AttendanceDate). Status: PRESENT / ABSENT / LATE / EXCUSED. No AttendanceSession or Submitted state.
Subject, Semester, Room, AcademicYear, GradeLevel and role classes are reused context and omitted here. Additional reviewer/requester/sender associations are omitted for clarity.
